assessment: This manuscript describes a pipeline involving whole brain imaging, automated neuronal segmentation, and topographical analysis, to assess the number of specific cell types in the larval Drosophila brain. The authors uncover unexpected sexual dimorphism at this early stage. This paper will be of interest to neuroscientists – from those who use larval Drosophila as their study model to others who are generally interested in connectomics and transcriptomics.
